The admin crawler intercepts writes to shared customer records; dedicated mutation tests use disposable fixtures instead.

review_threads.scope: Eight new follow-up threads addressed in 5916ea273, with evidence replies and resolution; no unresolved inline threads at observation.

follow_up_review_fixes: Choose the sanitizer report directory from the selected test configuration, preserving sanitizer-success upload gating.
Consume privileged HTTP response bodies before returning, retaining repeated reads and credential-safe failures.
Use verified billing customers despite stale legacy preferences; expose claim/support recovery without granting ambiguous-customer access; block new checkout and deletion until ownership resolves.

Test both Checkout intent time-window boundaries and stored customer-binding mismatches with zero-write assertions.
Normalize pointer/focus state and exclude still-transitioning styles from crawler effect credit; inert styling fails while handler-driven styling passes.
Compare entitlement ID and license key after real Checkout claim replay without leaking keys into assertion diagnostics.
Preserve primary payment-webhook verification failures when cleanup also fails.
Pin browser runner images to Ubuntu 24.04 because Playwright 1.58.2 rejected ubuntu-latest's Ubuntu 26.04.
Keep unresolved legacy Stripe accounts distinct from team-granted plans in billing UI, and reset portal/cancellation controls on every refreshed billing state.
